svg.title: MathCheck system architecture
svg.desc: Three-role system: teachers upload mark schemes, students upload work, AI grades and sends feedback, with teacher escalation for uncertain cases.

sendPrompt('How does the AI grading engine in MathCheck analyse student working steps?')
sendPrompt('What does the teacher see when MathCheck flags an uncertain submission for review?')
sendPrompt('What does the student feedback email from MathCheck look like?')
sendPrompt('What does the class summary email to teachers from MathCheck include?')
